Are you passionate about IT, enjoy solving technical problems, and like helping people?We are looking for an enthusiastic IT Support Intern to join our team and gain hands-on experience in a professional IT environment.

During your 3 months internship, you will work alongside experienced IT colleagues, support end users, and develop your knowledge of workplace technology, troubleshooting, ticket management, and IT processes.

What You Will Do

As an IT Service Desk Intern, you will support the team with day-to-day IT activities, including:

• Providing 1st-line IT support to users via phone and email
• Creating, updating, and following up on incidents and requests in our Helpdesk ticketing system
• Troubleshooting issues related to Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, PCs, printers, smartphones and peripherals
• Supporting basic user and access management, including Active Directory
• Preparing and staging laptops, PCs and other hardware for users
• Assisting with basic network, Wi-Fi and VPN troubleshooting
• Supporting meeting room technology and videoconferencing equipment
• Following technical procedures, checklists and IT processes
• Escalating more complex technical issues to experienced colleagues
• Contributing to a professional and customer-focused IT support experience

Who We're Looking For

You do not need to be an IT expert yet. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn and interested in developing a career in IT support.

Ideally, you:

• Are currently studying IT, System & Network Administration, or a related field
• Have a basic understanding of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365
• Have an interest in hardware, networking, Wi-Fi, VPN and IT infrastructure
• Have some basic knowledge of concepts such as TCP/IP, Active Directory or virtualization, or are motivated to learn
• Are analytical and enjoy troubleshooting technical problems
• Are proactive, responsible and solution-oriented
• Work well independently as well as within a team
• Have a strong customer and service mindset
• Communicate clearly and professionally
• Are comfortable following procedures and documenting your work
• Have a good command of Dutch, French and English
• Any knowledge of ITIL, VMware, VoIP, videoconferencing or networking is a plus, but certainly not a requirement.

Pattyn Group (€158 million turnover), headquartered in Bruges, is a pioneer in automated packaging solutions. We specialize in bulk packaging for a wide range of industries, including food, pharmaceuticals, and industrial goods. We design and build innovative, high-quality packaging machinery that seamlessly integrates into production lines, helping customers improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product safety throughout the packaging process.
 

We operate in five countries, with production sites in Bruges (Pattyn Belgium & Pattyn Metal Construction), Deerlijk (Pattyn Bulk Packaging), France (Pattyn France) and Spain (GMP) as well as sales and service centers in Kuala Lumpur (Pattyn Asia) and North America (Pattyn North America). With over 250 employees in Belgium and more than 600 colleagues worldwide, we continue to grow and strengthen our position as a global partner in packaging technology.
 

As a proud member of the 
Duravant family, a global leader in engineered equipment and automation solutions, Pattyn benefits from an extensive international network, strategic investments, and access to cutting-edge technologies. This partnership enables us to further expand our expertise, accelerate innovation, and deliver groundbreaking packaging solutions to customers around the world. Driven by a passionate team of professionals, we continuously push the boundaries of packaging automation while fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and rewarding environment where talented people can grow and make an impact.
 

Your challenge
 

The Group Accounting & Internal Controls Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent, accurate and compliant accounting practices across all Pattyn Group entities. 
 

The role drives the standardization of accounting policies, safeguards the integrity of financial reporting and internal controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for external auditors across the Group. 
 

In addition, the position plays a key role in improving the efficiency and reliability of financial closing processes, strengthening financial governance and supporting local finance teams in applying Group standards and best practices.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Group Accounting Governance & Compliance 

• External Audit Management 

• Internal Controls & SOX Compliance 

• Balance Sheet Integrity & Reconciliations 

• Financial Closing & Process Improvement 

• Stakeholder Management & Capability Building  

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) preferred. 

• Minimum 7 years of relevant experience, preferably including Big 4 audit and/or Group Accounting in a multinational environment. 

• Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or US GAAP, consolidation, SOX compliance and internal control frameworks. 

• Proven experience in external audit management and international accounting practices. 

• Strong analytical skills, technical rigor and attention to detail, with a high standard for accuracy and compliance. 

• Process-driven and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions. 

• Strong ownership, organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and coach local finance teams. 

• Strong ERP knowledge, advanced Excel skills and affinity with digitalization and automation. 

• Fluent English; French is a strong asset.

For a leading utilities client in Brussels, we are looking for an experienced Endpoint Engineer to strengthen the Endpoint Management team. This position offers the opportunity to work in a complex enterprise environment while contributing to the ongoing modernization of the workplace ecosystem.

Are you a sales-driven professional who knows how to open doors, enjoys negotiating, and thrives in a technical B2B environment? Do you also have experience in the data center industry? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you.For an internationally active company specialising in chemical solutions, we are looking for an International Business Development Manager to further develop its presence in the European data center market.You will join a financially strong organisation with international operations, its own R&D department, and a specialised product portfolio. At the same time, you will be part of a relatively small team where initiative, collaboration, and a hands-on approach are highly valued.What will you be doing?Data centers are becoming increasingly powerful, generating more and more heat in the process. To keep their infrastructure running reliably, they require specialised cooling solutions.Your role will be to identify commercial opportunities in this rapidly growing market and turn them into long-term customer relationships and successful business deals.More specifically, your responsibilities will include: 
• You will map the European data center market, identify business opportunities, and actively prospect for new customers. 
• You will establish relationships with data center operators, technical decision-makers, engineering companies, and other relevant industry players. 
• You will manage the entire sales process, from initial contact and negotiations through to securing commercial agreements. 
• You will develop long-term partnerships with existing customers and strategic business partners. 
• You will gain a thorough understanding of customers' technical requirements and work closely with internal specialists to propose suitable cooling solutions. 
• You will monitor market developments and translate your insights into targeted sales initiatives and concrete growth plans. 
• You will regularly liaise with colleagues in Asia and work closely with R&D, product management, marketing, and supply chain teams. 
• You will represent the company at international trade fairs, networking events, and industry meetings within the data center sector. 
• You will collaborate with another Business Development Manager, with customer segments divided between the two roles. You will report directly to the Business Manager.
We are not looking for a traditional Account Manager who mainly focuses on managing existing customers. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who enjoys developing new business, has a solid technical understanding, and knows how to turn commercial opportunities into tangible results.You recognise yourself in the following profile: 
• You have several years of experience in international B2B sales, business development, or strategic account management. 
• Ideally, you already have commercial experience in the data center industry and have built a relevant professional network. 
• You have a technical or chemical background, or at least a strong affinity for chemical products and technical applications. 
• You are a true sales hunter: prospecting, making new connections, and negotiating deals are what drive you. 
• You combine a strong commercial mindset with strategic thinking and a structured approach. 
• You are comfortable managing long sales cycles and building relationships with multiple decision-makers. 
• You have excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of another European language is an advantage. 
• You preferably hold a master's degree, combined with relevant professional experience. 
• You are willing to travel regularly, mainly within Europe. 
• You are preferably based in Belgium, although strong candidates based in Germany or France will also be considered.

European HQ Brussels | CNC Machine Expertise | Technical Sales Support | European Scope | International Environment | Permanent Contract

 
About The Organisation This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
 The organisation works with a network of dedicated distributors across different European countries. These local partners are responsible for selling and supporting the machines within their respective markets.

 To further strengthen its European sales activities, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical CNC expertise with strong commercial awareness. Depending on the candidate's background, the role can have a broader focus on CNC machines or a more specialised focus on fiber laser and press brake solutions.

 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy, short communication lines and regular collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders throughout Europe.

 
 
What will you do?Technical sales and pre-sales support

• Provide technical support to European distributors, Sales Managers and Sales Engineers.
• Advise on CNC machines, options, applications and configurations.
• Translate customer requirements into suitable technical solutions.
• Support sales teams throughout the commercial process, including product positioning, promotions and special pricing requests.
• Resolve technical or commercial issues that could delay a sale.
Relationship building and commercial insight

• Build strong relationships with distributors and local sales teams.
• Maintain regular contact to understand market needs, challenges and opportunities.
• Identify sales blockers, risks and potential business opportunities.
• Gather field feedback and translate it into actionable commercial insights.
• Share relevant market intelligence with the Sales Manager and internal teams.
Cross-functional coordination

• Collaborate with Sales, Applications, Service, Logistics, Marketing, IT and Product Management.
• Coordinate and follow up on cross-functional issues until resolution.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support new product launches across Europe.
Training, demonstrations and customer visits

• Deliver product and application training to distributors and sales teams.
• Demonstrate CNC machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support and coordinate customer and distributor visits to the European headquarters and showroom.
• Ensure machines, tooling and materials are ready for demonstrations.
• Support the coordination and smooth operation of the showroom.
Reporting and independent working

• Work autonomously and organise activities independently.
• Provide structured weekly reporting to the Sales Manager.
• Report and escalate sales blockers, missed opportunities and critical issues.
• Keep internal stakeholders informed about relevant customer and market developments.
 

What do you need?
Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering or another technical field.
• Equivalent technical expertise gained through professional experience can also be considered.
• At least approximately five years of relevant experience in a CNC, machining, manufacturing, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Practical knowledge of CNC machines or experience working in a production environment.
• Experience with machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers or press brakes is a strong advantage.
• The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience supporting sales teams, customers, distributors or other commercial stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects or working with different internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.
• The ability to work independently and confidently in an international environment.
• A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP is an advantage.Your strengthsYou are technically strong, communicative and commercially aware. You enjoy solving technical problems, but you also understand the urgency and business impact behind a sales opportunity.You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating different stakeholders and following issues through until they are resolved. As you will regularly work independently and travel throughout Europe, you can structure your own activities and make well-considered decisions. You are also:
• Mature and confident in your communication
• Hands-on and solution-oriented
• Proactive and responsive
• Customer-focused
• Commercially minded
• Structured and detail-oriented
• Comfortable working autonomously
• Capable of building trusted professional relationships
• Eager to deepen your knowledge of CNC machine technologies
• Able to remain calm and effective when priorities change or rapid action is required

jobs.description:
The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.
 
EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.
 
Dynamic and multi-cultural work environment.

Full-time position with extra-legal benefits: life insurance, hospitalization insurance (family included), meal tickets, transportation reimbursements, seniority leave, special holidays, training, Employee Assistance Program, etc.

Salary as of €4.466 gross/month.

Context

Europe in the spotlight. You at the heart of the action.

Ready for your next professional challenge? Euronews is looking for a Camera Operator to join its Brussels headquarters.

Work alongside talented professionals from around the world and be part of an exciting, dynamic environment, contributing to the news and show production.

This versatile role offers the opportunity to be involved in every stage of production, from filming and editing to broadcast, both in Brussels and in the field. Your work will span a wide range of formats, including live shots, two-ways, news reports, interviews and programmes.

Main responsibilities

The cameraman works alongside the journalists and correspondents of the Brussels office. The main responsibilities include:

Filming and camera operation (field and studio)

Editing and post-production

Technical operations and production

• Operating equipment: cameras, lighting, players and recorders, vision mixer, audio console and audio equipment, production automation, cloud-based production system.
• Using production techniques: chroma key, virtual studio, physical sets.
• Receiving, processing and distributing external feeds and files (pools, agencies, debate and election night feeds).

Required Skills and Qualifications 

Technical skills

• Experience: at least 5 years in a similar role (camera operator/video journalist) at a TV channel or news agency.

• Driving licence preferred.
 Versatility, team spirit and a service-oriented mindset.

jobs.occupation: Researcher - PhD Candidate in Political Economy / International Relations (FRACTURE) M/W/X
jobs.description:
MAIN TASKS

• Conduct doctoral research in international relations, defence policy and international security.
• Develop the theoretical framework of the project, including an extensive review of the literature on alliances, strategic alignment, great-power competition and cooperation among revisionist powers.
• Collect, structure and analyse quantitative and qualitative data concerning the relations among China, Russia, Iran and North Korea.
• Develop a dataset covering cooperation in several domains, including economic, diplomatic, military and technological relations.
• Apply network analysis techniques to map and analyse the structure and evolution of cooperation among the four states.
• Produce network visualisations and quantitative indicators identifying patterns, central actors and asymmetries.
• Conduct qualitative and comparative case studies of episodes of cooperation, competition and geopolitical tension.
• Analyse the political, economic and strategic drivers of cooperation as well as structural asymmetries, dependencies and potential vulnerabilities.
• Contribute to scientific publications, working papers, policy briefs, blog posts and other dissemination outputs.
• Present research results at international academic conferences, RMA seminars and Defence-oriented events.
• Contribute to the activities of relevant academic and institutional research networks, including NATO-related research activities.
• Support knowledge transfer between academic research and Belgian Defence stakeholders.v 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree required / ideal degree:

Master's degree in Economics, Political Economy, International Relations, Political Science, or a related field.

This position is open to junior or early-career researchers (0-3 years of experience).

The position is intended for a researcher interested in pursuing a PhD trajectory within the framework of the FRACTURE project.

 

MUST HAVE

• Strong background in political economy, international relations, or related fields 
• Ability to analyse complex geopolitical and international security issues.
• Strong analytical and academic writing skills.
• Ability and motivation to conduct independent scientific research.
• Interest in both quantitative and qualitative research methods.
 

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with network analysis / data analysis tools (e.g. R, Python, Gephi, etc.) 
• Knowledge of the foreign and security policies of China, Russia, Iran and/or North Korea.
• Familiarity with alliance theory, strategic studies or defence policy.
• Experience working with international economic, diplomatic or security-related datasets.
• Experience with qualitative case-study research.
• Experience with policy-oriented or Defence-related research.
• Experience writing policy briefs or communicating research to non-academic audiences.
 

PERSONAL SKILLS

• Ability to work independently in a multidisciplinary research environment 
• Analytical, critical, and creative thinking 
• Clear and effective communication (oral and written) 
• Proactive, organized, and result-oriented 
• Strong team spirit and collaboration skills 
• High level of integrity and confidentiality
 

OTHER SKILLS

• Excellent command of English (oral and written) 
• Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset 
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.
 
 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From March 1st, 2027, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant). Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until 28/02/2031.
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree), with valuable/relevant seniority. A salary simulation can be done here : Simulateur de salaire. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance (15€ / month);
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) 
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

jobs.description:
#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee. 

 

How can you apply? 

 

• Before you apply, check more information https://europecareers.ab-inbev.com/programmes/graduate-management-traineeship  
• Please be advised that you will only be considered for the first application you submit, therefore please make sure you are completely happy with your choice as this decision is final. 
• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits: 

• Learning & Development opportunities  
• Quarterly vouchers to taste our delicious beers 
• Legal holidays + Compensation & additional days (40 Days in total for fulltime employment) 
• A unique Parental leave 
• Multiple Physical & Mental Wellbeing support Initiatives 
• Meal vouchers, allowances, gift per company policy 
• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.)
